characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH ONLY: a frame from a live-action Japanese drama shot on a cinema camera — real human skin with pores and fine lines, real fabric weave, real wood grain; NOT an illustration, NOT anime, NOT a painting, NOT CGI. EXPRESSION FIRST — the face must read clearly at a glance on a phone screen, at about 60 percent intensity, overriding the neutral expression of any reference image: Expression — DULL INDIFFERENCE: heavy eyelids, eyes fixed on the phone glow below the frame, brows flat, the mouth slightly open and slack, no muscle engaged anywhere in the face; the blue phone light hollowing the cheeks. ACTING REALISM: this is a real actor caught mid-thought, not a posed portrait — a subtle NATURAL ASYMMETRY between the two sides of the face, the emotion held mainly in the EYES and the tiny muscles around them (lower eyelids, inner brows, nostrils, the corners of the mouth), the skin reacting (faint flush or pallor where the emotion demands), a believable breath in the chest; NO exaggerated theatrical grimace, NO stock smile with teeth, NO blank mannequin stare, NO perfectly symmetrical frozen face. Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting. [CAMERA] MOBILE-FIRST COMPOSITION: this will be watched on a 6-inch phone screen — the key subject (face, hand or object) is LARGE and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, high local contrast between subject and background, nothing important near the frame edges or in tiny far-off detail; the lower fifth of the frame stays visually simple (subtitles will sit there). FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Mouth CLOSED (lips together, no teeth visible); facing the camera, looking into the lens. low-angle looking up, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh, cinematic portrait. Exactly one person in sharp focus, no foreground shoulder, hands out of frame, chest-up single close-up, facing the camera within 30 degrees. [CHARACTER] Reference image 1 is the expression cell of Takayuki (36, soft doughy face, unkempt black hair, faint stubble, NO glasses, wrinkled grey cardigan over a white shirt): copy exactly this face, hair, eyewear, faint stubble and wardrobe, and use this emotional expression only as a starting point (about 60 percent intensity) — the detailed expression text below overrides it; ignore its plain background and any borders or labels. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. Takayuki, a Japanese man aged 35, round soft face, slightly heavy build, faint chin stubble, short unkempt black hair, tired eyes, NO glasses, wearing a plain charcoal-grey cotton samue jacket and trousers over a plain black crew-neck shirt, no crest. [ACTION] NO smartphone and NO hands anywhere in the frame — the phone is BELOW the bottom edge, out of shot; the frame is cut at mid-chest. The ONLY light on his face is the cold blue-white glow of the smartphone held below the frame, lighting him from beneath the chin; the paper lamp is a faint warm dot far behind; the rest of the room is near black. Low angle chest-up of Takayuki, his face lit cold blue-white from below by the phone screen (out of frame), eyes down toward it, bored and tired. [SETTING] Lighting: night, the cold blue-white glow of a smartphone screen on the face, a faint warm paper lamp far behind, darkness around.  All papers, screens, signs, scrolls, plates and the noren curtain are completely blank and plain; no letters, numbers, crests or symbols anywhere in the frame; every wall is bare. WALL RULE: every wall is completely bare — NO paper notices, NO posters, NO calendars, NO framed writing; NO noren curtain and NO hanging cloth unless the location reference shows one, and then it is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest. Couple's private room: bare walls, NO noren, NO posters, no phone on the floor; only the futon, the paper lamp and the window. FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Soft fill light keeps the mouth and jaw readable (lip-sync cut). Mouth gently closed or barely parted (speech is added later); natural skin texture, both eyes sharp and symmetrical in focus. [NEGATIVE] Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere in the image. gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, brand logos, crest on noren, family emblem, signage lettering, posters with writing, paper notices on walls, printed labels, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, anime, illustration.
